# Status check contexts required by the "Basic" branch ruleset on main.
#
# This file is the declared contract between two things that live apart and
# cannot see each other:
#
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml   — produces these contexts (job `name:` values)
#   - the branch ruleset on main — requires them before a PR can merge
#
# A required context nothing produces never reports. GitHub shows it as
# "Expected — waiting for status to be reported" forever, so the PR is blocked
# by a check that will never run. That is not hypothetical: consolidating two
# CI jobs into one between PR #26 and #27 left two stale contexts required, and
# the next two PRs merged past them unnoticed.
#
# `make check` asserts ci.yml's job names match this list exactly.
# `scripts/check-ruleset.sh` (manual, needs gh auth) asserts the live ruleset
# does too — the direction CI cannot see, since editing a ruleset in GitHub's
# UI changes no file and triggers no workflow.
#
# Renaming a CI job means updating this file AND the ruleset, in the same PR.
# One line per context, exact match, comments and blank lines ignored.

make check (manifests + harness tests)
Version bump + CHANGELOG on plugin changes
